comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record measures subfloor flatness and reports pass/fail.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part assembly and fastening versus bimanual straightedge placement, deepest-gap search, wedge measurement, and classification.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent mechanical retention at one rack unit versus wedge left in the deepest gap and the correct PASS/FAIL tag selected.
comparison.reason: The record tests inspection and measurement, not attachment or latching.
